steps.label: Check on Maria after a month away (Follower rank 7).
Enter the Varmareno Coliseum's Ranked League and win Bronze II.
Accompany Eupha to the church for Ovi's mother (Follower rank 4).
Join Junah at the Brilehaven tailor (Follower rank 4).
Answer Maria's summons at the inn (Follower rank 8).
Take the cooking lesson with Maria and Fabienne — follow each dish's cue.
Check on Ovi and the others with Eupha (Follower rank 5).
Keep Junah positive before the festival (Follower rank 5).
The lance must be in hand today — wrap up the Drakodios trail.
Warp to Martira and slay the human greatworm with Strohl's General buffs (Follower rank 7 for Bardon).
Dragon Festival: invite a companion to the flames and grant their wish for a unique weapon of their Archetype.
Depart for Altabury Heights.
Use the second planned Tail Bait and again target 1 Lord of the Lake + 2 Queen's Honey Jars. Match the prompt with: 'Give in to naptime.', 'Thrash and Splash', or 'Think like a fish.'
Start 'How to Walk Outside the Island' (Eupha's book) before bed.
Continue 'How to Walk Outside the Island' (Eupha's book).
Stop by Colerodio Cliff.
Reflect on the past with Eupha in the lounge.
Finish 'How to Walk Outside the Island'.
Tolerance reaches rank 5 (Saviour).
Pass the Murky Graveyard.

On arrival in Altabury, collect five Gold Beetles: both Lunlumo Approach spots (east sidewalk and the dead-end stairs), Blue Sky Bridge between the weapon and item shops, Opera House Square at the end of the bridge, and after dark the cauldron pot inside Whitepeaks Magic Shop.
Collect Altabury's sixth town Gold Beetle beside the barrels and fruit in the Skyward Tavern corner; take 'Village Trading: Altabury Heights' from the Informant.
Dia Franco Street shopping: Brocaded Koi from the Dedicated Butcher and the frayed goods for trading.
Attend the Opera House — the production turns into a duel to the death.
See how the town reacts to the Opera House news, then rest.
Clear the Royal Academy Ruins — break Rella's Quartz Wall every turn and guard Sogne's fire.
Ten days remain before the duel in Grand Trad — plan the candidate runner hunts.
Tell Loveless where you'll settle it; take 'Warmth in Winter' from the Portly Man.
Take 'Proof of Power' from the Obsessive Soldier and 'The Fiend in the Frozen Forest' from the Recruitment Centre.
Meet Catherina after reaching Altabury and hear what she plans next (Follower rank 5).
Help Eupha with Ovi and the others (Follower rank 6); receive 'Wayward Shepherd'.
Debate Julian at the Blue Sky Bridge podium (answer: the present day matters too).
Cook Amber Stew, then set off for Malva.
Junah shows you something in the lounge (Follower rank 6).
Loveless boards the runner — an easy fight after the Opera House.
Malva stop: visit the town after the runner fight and buy the Durable Spider Silk for Warmth in Winter plus Altabury Wheat Flour for tomorrow's cooking.
Back in Altabury, accept Loveless' 'Defeat Milo' request and hand the Durable Spider Silk to the Portly Man to complete 'Warmth in Winter'.
Cook Enchanted Pottage with the flour from Malva, then hunt Milo's runner.
With Tolerance rank 5 secured, continue Catherina's cause before departure (Follower rank 6).
Basilio introduces himself in the Engine Room Corridor (Follower rank 1).
Milo's duel: mirror his Mage Mirror turns and burst him down.
Return to Loveless after the duel to complete 'Defeat Milo'.
Cook Adamantine Honey Cake, then run down Rudolf's runner.
Start the 'Literacy Workbook' Basilio added (Follower rank 7 for Junah).
Rudolf's duel: his team is physical-focused — raise defense and counter.
Check on Basilio's shopping (Follower rank 2).
Meet Catherina at Lower Blue Sky Bridge (Follower rank 7).
Cook Cursed Loved Ballad (or pack Hex cleansers) and fly to Mt. Vulkano for Eupha's request.
Continue the 'Literacy Workbook'.
Imagination reaches rank 5 (Demiurgic).
Clear Mt. Vulkano for 'Wayward Shepherd'; collect its Gold Beetle and the Stitched Sphere relic for a later Neuras turn-in, then take the Rusty Greatsword before the boss.
Fly to Everfrost Forest; cook Indestructible Honey Cake (save one for a request).
Cook the first 20 recipes once each — this unlocks the 21st recipe, Sublime Spoonful.
Chat with Basilio (Follower rank 3), then stop at Solstice Crossing on the way.
Clear Everfrost Forest for 'The Fiend in the Frozen Forest'; collect the Gold Beetle at the far southwest and Neuras' relic before defeating Icebeast Chimenzahn.
Report the Icebeast hunt at the Recruitment Centre.
Before continuing to Scoundrel's Hold, show Neuras one of the recovered relics: complete 'Relic Search: Engineer's Destiny' and start 'Relic Search: Bitter Memories' (Follower rank 5).
Ligno stop: visit the town on the way to Scoundrel's Hold and browse its specialist weapons and equipment. This is the route's fifth Globetrotter town.
Finish the 'Literacy Workbook' — with all seven books complete, Bookworm unlocks.
Clear Scoundrel's Hold — collect the Gold Beetle on B2 via the ladder from B3, recover Neuras' Parquet Chest relic, then finish the dungeon.
Report the Scoundrel's Hold quest; inn cooking remains available through September 25.
Help Basilio look for Vinca (Follower rank 4).
Visit Myrtus with Junah (Follower rank 8).
Depart for the Royal Capital — the duel with Louis is now.
Gallica reaches Follower rank 7; talk with your allies before bed.
Browse the upgraded Sunshade Row stock and grab a Soothing Sweetbun.
Take the stage at Regalith Grand Cathedral — push Louis to the story threshold.
Set course for the Ancient Eldan Sanctum; in the Plaza of Light collect the one-time Gold Beetle beside the collapsed house before entering the Prayer Room.
At the Altar of Secret History, reject the false ending and study the Prince Archetype — His Majesty unlocks.
Gallica reaches Follower rank 8.

Return to Grand Trad; collect the newly available Gold Beetle at the east-side food stall in the Regalith Grand Cathedral area, then visit Akademeia as More's deciphered scrolls unlock the Royal Archetypes.
Hand over the Rusty Greatsword for 'The Edge of Glory' — thirty days remain until the crowning.
Take the three final Recruitment Centre bounties: 'The Incarnate in the Woods', 'The Cockatrice in the Clouds', and 'The Apostles of the Apocalypse'.
Take 'The Queen of Cuisine: Soul' from the Classy Woman and hand over the saved Indestructible Honey Cake — receive 1 Lord of the Lake.
Collect the three tower requests — 'Trial of the Dragon: Mad Mischief', 'Heroes' Rest', and 'Bygone Legacy' — plus 'Deliver Hot Spring Water' from the Gentle Merchant at Blue Sky Bridge.
Basilio's next step (Follower rank 5); catch up with Brigitta (Follower rank 8).
Visit the recovered Bardon (Follower rank 8), then collect Martira's two post-9/26 Gold Beetles: left of the Cattleracket Road staircase and just off-screen to the right of MesmerEyes Apothecary.
Hear Catherina's announcement to her paripus mates (Follower rank 8).
Convince Basilio to act and find Vinca together (Follower rank 6).
Show Neuras another recovered relic: complete 'Relic Search: Bitter Memories' and start 'Relic Search: A Dream's Origin' (Follower rank 6).
Rest at the Lycaon Magic Association bench for the post-9/26 eight-coin Wisdom boost.
Deliver the final required relic to Neuras: complete 'Relic Search: A Dream's Origin' (Follower rank 7); 'Petty Thief' then starts to recover the stolen relics.
Depart for the Disgraced Ruins; cook Sublime Spoonful, the 21st and final recipe — King of Cuisine unlocks.
Plant seeds in the Plant Culture Chamber, then stop at Malibelo Stope and receive the Malibelo Stope Drawing.
Wisdom reaches rank 5 (Sagacious).

At Disgraced Ruins, collect the Gold Beetle just west of the dungeon entrance; before the boss, master any Elite Archetype and turn in 'More's Task Chapter Six: The End' — More reaches Follower rank 8.
